description: Fetches Bible passages from natural-language references such as "John 3:16-18", "Psalm 23", "Romans 8:1-9:5" (crossing chapters) or "John 3:16; Romans 8:1" (several at once). This is the primary lookup tool when the user gives a citation instead of structured book/chapter/verse fields.

reference.description: One or more free-form Bible references. Accepts localized book names, abbreviations, whole chapters ("Psalm 23"), verse ranges ("John 3:16-18"), chapter ranges ("Genesis 1-3"), ranges that cross chapters ("Romans 8:1-9:5"), and several references separated by semicolons or commas ("John 3:16; Romans 8:1"). At most 10 per call.

version.description: Optional Bible version slug. If omitted, uses the first version enabled by the connection URL, or "bsb" (English) when no version filter exists. When the user writes in another language, pass a version in that language.

name: get_passage

copyright.description: Attribution the version license requires (e.g. CC BY-SA). Present only for versions that need it; show it with the text.

reader_url.description: Link to read the passage on midvash.com.

book.description: Book name in the language of the version.
